Two petals on the lower right side appear to merge or fuse at their bases near the yellow center, lacking a clear separation line. This 'melting' effect is a common AI artifact in dense floral generations.
The granular texture of the yellow center becomes unnaturally uniform and repetitive towards the edges, lacking the random variation of biological growth. It looks slightly stamped rather than grown.
